title: Upstash
description: Serverless data platform delivering Redis, Kafka, Vector database, and QStash with pay-per-request pricing and REST API connectivity for edge environments.
features: Serverless Redis with true HTTP/REST API support, enabling connection-pool-free edge queries
Serverless Kafka message streaming with per-message billing and zero cluster provisioning
QStash: Serverless messaging and webhook orchestrator with automatic retries and deduplication
Serverless Vector database designed specifically for AI similarity search at the edge
Global multi-zone replication with sub-millisecond read latency
pros: True pay-as-you-go model: zero idle charges when your app has no traffic
Works flawlessly in stateless edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Fastly)
cons: REST-based Redis queries have slightly higher latency than local TCP sockets
Memory limits on the free tier make it suited for caching rather than bulk storage
targetAudience: Edge developers, Next.js builders, and engineers needing serverless caching and rate-limiting.
